notes.title: Demo Patch Notes (09/23/2025)
notes.notes: [p]More updates! Today's update addresses more crashes and a nasty softlock.[/p][p]Thank you once more for your dedication to our demo! Remember to head to the [url="https://discord.gg/ftmCfsupyv"]Community Discord Server[/url] to mingle with those who've played and report bugs more directly![/p][p][/p][h3]Full Patch Notes (09/23/2025):[/h3][p][/p][p]Bugfixes:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed several crashes surrounding the French Cuisine moveset[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Shield Moves would crash the game if a certain Passive was equipped[/p][/*][*][p]Cook! keyword now fails if BLANK has no more inventory space[/p][/*][*][p]Potluck! keyword can now no longer damage BLANK[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash associated with swapping moves[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a softlock that would brick a run in CA map "Floor 3?", associated with Simply You's introduction cutscene[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Other changes:[/p][list][*][p]Streamline Shopkeeper dialogue slightly[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes (09/22/2025)
notes.notes: [p]Another day, another update! We're beginning to catch up. [/p][p]This one is intended to address the major softlocks found in the Field of Forget-Me-Nots "Down the Drain" map, and the maze-like map in the Complex Apartments. If these two maps should still easily softlock your game, please do let us know![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for continuing to play the Blanksword demo and your immense support![/p][p][/p][h3]Full Patch Notes (09/22/2025):[/h3][p][/p][p]Bugfixes:[/p][list][*][p]Fix a function associated with [b]38[/b] Move Evolutions that used the wrong sign to calculate damage output[/p][/*][*][p]Hopefully fix a softlock in FOFMN map "Down the Drain", where no keys would spawn[/p][/*][*][p]Hopefully fix a softlock in CA map "Turn another corner; there you are" where no exit and/or no gift-room would spawn[/p][/*][*][p]Fix Hide status effect adding a ridiculous amount of extra-Shield[/p][/*][*][p]Completely overhaul "Quit to Title" functionality, hopefully squashing several save-corrupting issues in the process[/p][/*][*][p]Fix OOB in FOFMN map "A House on Fire"[/p][/*][*][p]Fix Tenderness Evos[/p][/*][*][p]Fix Shield Bash evolution "Shield Crash"... [i]crashing[/i] the game[/p][/*][*][p]Remove two respawn points in Single Room map "The Park" that could be used to circumvent an important choke-point[/p][/*][*][p]Make it impossible for moves to evolve more than once[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Other changes:[/p][list][*][p]Make Your Happy Home-Owner hopefully say something utterly wretched when attacked in his sleep[/p][/*][*][p]Allow Players to rematch the Mold Beast! Perhaps even more than once per run, if you're lucky...![/p][/*][*][p]Improve timing on secret ending-cutscene[/p][/*][*][p]Add short name to Philosophical Edge[/p][/*][*][p]Fix several typos[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes (09/21/2025)
notes.notes: [p]Once more, here's an update to the demo build![/p][p]This one is very important, as it resolves several crashes, and a game-breaking bug.[/p][p]We're extremely grateful for the outpouring of love from all of you who've played the demo so far, and hope to continue to make it a smoother experience![/p][p][/p][h3]Full Patch Notes (09/21/2025):[/h3][p][/p][p]Bugfixes:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed crashes associated with _move_inv_length[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed crashes associated with unit_move_queue[/p][/*][*][p]Fix a persistent crash that would break the save file of anyone unlucky enough to backtrack through a certain Finite Forest map. (If you are affected by this: Reloading your save now will make it work again!)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed crashes that occur when multiple reward types are present at the end of battle[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed crashes associated with o_HITBOX and sword-slashing[/p][/*][*][p]Fix Pep Talk and Hurful Words evos[/p][/*][*][p]Attempt to fix an issue with the dialogue-system's positioning that would embed the player in a wall[/p][/*][*][p]Fix wrong-warp in the Complex Apartments' second floor[/p][/*][*][p]Fix several more move evolutions' level thresholds[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Other changes:[/p][list][*][p]Gave the three-dog party in the Dog Arena map a red "elite encounter" outline[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various typos[/p][/*][*][p]Improve conveyance on Sensitive Foliage's store description[/p][/*][*][p]Fill in some missing Angel of the Mind Notes[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes (09/19/2025)
notes.notes: [p]Further bugfixes since yesterday! There are many to work through, so please excuse if a bug you've found hasn't quite been addressed yet.[/p][p]If you should find any crashes or bugs, feel free let us know[url="https://discord.gg/ftmCfsupyv"] in our Discord[/url]![/p][p][/p][h3]Full patch notes (09/19/2025):[/h3][p][/p][p]Bugfixes[/p][list][*][p]Fix an issue where having the Sensitive Foliage equipped would crash the game on toggling Key Items.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix a crash related to Remember-Me and Existential Crisis[/p][/*][*][p]Fix a crash associated with the stat-menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fix Venomskin's evolutions[/p][/*][*][p]Make Waterbug Arts able to evolve again[/p][/*][*][p]Fix several Gossip-error rainbow-text bugs[/p][/*][*][p]Remove unfinished move "Snail Arts"[/p][/*][*][p]Fix application of "On-Kill" keyword effects for several move evolutions[/p][/*][*][p]Fix volume and frequency of certain blipspeak sounds[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Other changes[/p][list][*][p]Fix various typos in move descriptions[/p][/*][*][p]Improve conveyance on Brain Part menu[/p][/*][*][p]Remove Wile E. Coyote-style joke at the player's expense in Broken Bridge map, related to collecting EXP in mid-air. It was fun while it existed![/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Day 1 Patch Notes
notes.notes: [p]It's time for our Demo's first update! Today and yesterday's patches address some gnarly collision bugs - we've also fixed some unintended behaviors and added some quality of life improvements. [/p][p]If you run into any bug or issue during your travels inside His Country, you can hop[url="https://discord.gg/ftmCfsupyv"] into our Discord[/url] and let us know :] [/p][p][/p][h3]Full patch notes (09/18/2025):[/h3][p][/p][p]Bugfixes[/p][list][*][p]Attempt a fix at an issue where collision from either hazards or walls would carry over from one map to the next and cause crashes and softlocks[/p][/*][*][p]Fix an issue where slashing a Chest and an enemy simultaneously would break battle display[/p][/*][*][p]Fix unavailable move descriptions for several move evolutions that would crash the game[/p][/*][*][p]Fix Shadow Clones animating while the menu is open[/p][/*][*][p]Fix missing keyword tooltip on "Gourmet Slash"[/p][/*][*][p]Fix Gates not resetting properly on-death[/p][/*][*][p]Fix Talksounds not being beholden to Master Volume[/p][/*][*][p]Fix several typos[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Other changes[/p][list][*][p]Added key-item equivalents to all brain parts so players can keep track of which parts they do and do not have[/p][/*][*][p]Add a missing credit to the Credits[/p][/*][/list]
